memory.query:
SELECT cluster, task_id, attempt_id, worker_id, count(*) AS samples,
 min(ts) AS first_ts, max(ts) AS last_ts,
 max(memory_mb) / 1024.0 AS max_sampled_gib,
 max(memory_peak_mb) / 1024.0 AS reported_peak_gib
FROM "iris.task"
WHERE task_id LIKE '/kaiyuew@stanford.edu/ema-gram-20-loss-pair-replicated-v4-32-20261103/%'
 AND ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-11-03 23:21:31'
 AND ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-11-04 00:06:00'
GROUP BY cluster, task_id, attempt_id, worker_id
ORDER BY task_id, attempt_id
